remaining.site: voltFiles/common/filesBroker.ts filesPlan (brokerReadRefusal / brokerWriteRefusal, re-exported by hostToolSandbox.ts as sandboxReadRefusal / sandboxWriteRefusal)
remaining.reason: The files broker's floor and scope on one path (credential folders, secret files, execution-bearing files, the principal's folders, a chat's own OS rule). It refuses only; the capability is always asked of `evaluate` after it (the host-tool gate's HostToolAuthority.filesRefusal, the broker's brokerEvaluate). Not a second allow list.

Since C3 every byte a sandboxed chat's agent or browser partition sends goes through its network broker route, which asks the Authority (`net.connect` with the port, the special-range floor, exfil hosts by exact name). These page-level checks run before it and can only refuse more; they stay so a refused page is explained before any request is made.
